Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific educational details from the Wikipedia page it visited in Step 3. Although the page clearly displayed "Education: Harvard University (BA)" and the text "Burroughs attended Harvard University... and went on to medical school in Vienna," the agent's response in Step 4 simply repeated the search query and showed the search results page again instead of navigating to the URL provided in its own instructions (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Seward_Burroughs_II) to read the content. This failure to utilize the browsing capability to extract the available information led to a cycle of redundant searches without gathering the necessary facts to answer the user's question.
